versions.changelog:
- Renamed to "smart-ppt-generator" for clearer branding.
- Streamlined and clarified documentation for setup, usage, and workflow.
- Updated description to highlight AI capability, smart style detection, and no API requirement.
- Expanded feature list: added preview/confirmation flow, auto color scheme refresh, and high-end mode details.
- Improved dependency, command, and troubleshooting instructions for easier onboarding.

Initial release of smart-ppt-generator:

- Generate professional PowerPoint presentations with integrated design skills.
- Supports two modes: frontend-design for standard layouts and canvas-design for advanced visual effects.
- Outputs PPTX files, hosted via FileBrowser for easy downloading.
- Includes preview (3 PNG images) before final PPTX generation.
- Customizable style, topic, and color palette, with auto-refresh options.
- Requires node, bash, puppeteer, pptxgenjs, and design skills dependencies.
